message:
Console v0.4.26 consumption path: rebuild pending patch semantically (#7)

* console: rebuild v0.4.26 consumer freeze path (semantic, not applied patch)

The handoff console-pending-unpublished.patch (sha256 f3dc1b11) targeted
v0.4.25 release-integration bookkeeping whose context no longer exists:
main rewired the immutable consumer lock to a v0.4.24 binding model and
pins Core d5417bde with all six contract artifacts matching the lock's
SHA-256 (verified; CI's source-lock check at ci.yml:59-66). The patch's
three hunks were classified STALE/never-landed and rebuilt semantically.

integration-candidate.json now declares release 0.4.26 with core pinned
to the frozen Core d5417bde (fixing the latent mismatch with the
source-lock core_commit asserted by release-integration-origin.mjs:20).
The demo field is left as an explicit PENDING-FREEZE for the v0.4.26
Demo SHA; no fake or guessed Demo SHA is published (pins target Core/Demo
SHAs that freeze later).

* ci: validate consumer candidate manifest on PR changes

integration-candidate.json is the release-integration manifest that
release-integration-candidate.mjs and release-integration-origin.mjs
consume, but it was not in the ci.yml pull_request paths filter, so
changes to the Core/Demo consumer pins ran CI-unverified. Add it to the
filter so the frozen consumer pins are validated by CI.

* refreeze C->2adae47a; demo pin 896dc3c; re-lock source-lock

* refreeze C: sync locked control.golden/schema from Core 2adae47a; fix source-lock hashes
